challenges.prompt: In what year was the paper 'Attention Is All You Need' published, introducing the Transformer architecture?
What is the name of the technique that randomly deactivates neurons during training to prevent overfitting?
What does RLHF stand for in the context of AI training?
What is the term for the phenomenon where a language model confidently states false information?
I have billions of parameters but no memory of you. I process everything at once but forget instantly. I speak every language but was never taught to speak. What am I?
The more layers I have, the deeper I understand. Remove my weights and I go silent. Add noise during my training and I generalize better. I am a method, not a model. What am I?
I turn words into numbers, numbers into meaning, and meaning back into words. I am the first and last step in every modern language model. What am I?
I am the mechanism that lets a model know which parts of its own input matter most. I attend to everything at once. Without me, Transformers would not exist. What am I?
I measure how wrong you are. Make me smaller and you improve. Make me zero and you overfit. Every model lives and dies by me. What am I?
